summary: Iteration 3 verified the NEW ARMI features: rental EDIT, multiple payments per rental, invoice PDF, WhatsApp Kirim Invoice, and calendar filters. Backend: full pytest suite 76/76 passing (added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py with 8 focused cases covering DP + additional payment + overpay-reject + Bayar penuh->Lunas, edit preserves transaksi_id, edit vehicle on Aktif releases old vehicle and disewa's the new one, edit type Harian->24 Jam recalcs jumlah_hari and harga override, edit overlap 409, public invoice PDF %PDF- header + application/pdf CT, dashboard.outstanding + reports.total_paid/outstanding present). Also fixed 2 stale iteration_2 test assertions that still expected the removed manual status_pembayaran PATCH and old 'DP' label (payment status is now auto-derived: 'Belum Dibayar' / 'DP / Sebagian' / 'Lunas'). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080): admin login OK; create rental Harian with Rp 100.000 DP -> paid=Rp 100.000 / sisa=Rp 800.000, add Rp 50.000 -> paid=Rp 150.000 / sisa=Rp 750.000, 'Bayar penuh' -> sisa=Rp 0 & auto 'Lunas'; Edit customer through rental-save-edit + rental-edit-confirm (summary AlertDialog) succeeded and persisted after refresh; GET /api/invoices/{id} returned 200 application/pdf 2776 bytes; WA 'Kirim Invoice' link href is https://wa.me/62... with message containing customer name, No. Invoice TRX-..., vehicle, dates, Total, Sisa and /api/invoices/{id} URL; Calendar filters work (baseline 4 items -> vehicle-only 1 item -> vehicle+Harian 1 item, options include Semua Kendaraan/Semua Tipe/Semua Status); Dashboard shows 'Total Sisa Tagihan Rp 1.240.000' via data-testid stat-outstanding; Reports shows report-total-paid Rp 1.800.000 and report-outstanding Rp 1.240.000. Overpay-reject (backend 400) confirmed via pytest (frontend button is disabled/limited by paySisa max, so UI can't submit >sisa). Regression on rest of app: unchanged from iteration_2 (Aktif-now vs Booking confirm flow, Mulai Rental, Cancel booking, double-booking prevention, vehicle & customer CRUD, customer rental history, search & filters) still passing. No new functional defects found in the iteration-3 scope.

minor.issue: Passing status_pembayaran in the body is silently ignored (payment status is now derived from payments). Consider returning 400 for unknown payload keys so old integrations fail loudly.

Endpoint is public by design (shareable link) but leaks full customer PII (name, WhatsApp, address) to anyone who guesses/knows a rental UUID. UUID is unguessable but an authenticated + signed-URL variant would be safer.

Iteration_2 minors still open: login_attempts counter not reset on lock expiry, brute-force keyed by email only, revenue includes 'Booking' status, 6-month chart uses i*30-day arithmetic, CORS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=true, server.py >1100 lines still one module.

issues: Multiple DialogContent still missing aria Description/aria-describedby -> React console warning (mobile Sheet + edit/payment dialogs).

Dev-mode 'Uncaught runtime errors: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' overlay from Recharts container in Rentals page; benign in prod but blocks Playwright dropdown clicks and is user-visible in dev.

design_issues.screen: Rental form (Harian + 24 Jam) and Reports Kustom
issues: Native <input type=date>/<input type=datetime-local> pickers still show US 'mm/dd/yyyy' placeholders inside an all-Bahasa-Indonesia UI (same finding as iterations 1 & 2; shadcn Calendar not adopted).

stat/report values render as one string ('Rp 1.800.000Sudah Dibayar') because label and value share the same testid element without a visual/text separator - cosmetic only, add a space or wrap label in its own testid'd span.

action_items: Nothing blocking. Optional: (a) 400 on unknown keys in PATCH /rentals/{id}/status, (b) consider signed/authenticated invoice URLs given PII exposure, (c) still-open iteration_2 items (login-attempt reset, CORS wildcard with credentials, revenue excluding Booking, native date pickers, server.py split).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from ~815 to ~1160 lines with the new invoice/payments/edit code; still one module, still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (auth, vehicles, customers, rentals, payments, invoices, dashboard, reports, seed).

GET /api/invoices/{id} is intentionally public; because it returns customer name/whatsapp/address a leaked rental UUID = PII leak. Either require the token (already stored in localStorage & sent as Bearer) or issue a signed one-time link.
release_vehicle_if_free() duplicates the availability logic already inside sync_vehicle_status(); merge to a single helper to avoid drift.
compute_payment() calls sum() over p.get('amount', 0) but does not defensively cast to float; a bad legacy payment record could raise TypeError inside enrich_rental and cascade to /rentals list.
Frontend Rentals.js is now ~600+ lines with create form, edit form, payment modal, WA menu and 4 dialogs; extract RentalForm / PaymentModal / RentalCard.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated 2 stale iteration_2 assertions after status_pembayaran PATCH removal)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-3 scope (14 UI checks passed: create+DP, add payment, Bayar penuh->Lunas, edit customer w/ confirm dialog, invoice PDF 200/pdf, WA link content, 3 calendar filters, dashboard Total Sisa Tagihan, reports Sudah Dibayar & Sisa Tagihan)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed added. Created ~5 rentals with 2027-08 dates via UI + pytest fixtures; all deleted by /app/backend/tests/cleanup_frontend_qa.py (deleted 1 residual, vehicle statuses reset). DB baseline confirmed: 6 rentals, tersedia/disewa/maintenance in sync.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 features (rental EDIT, multi-payments, invoice PDF, WA Kirim Invoice, calendar filters, Total Sisa Tagihan card, Reports paid/outstanding) verified end-to-end. Payment status is now DERIVED, not settable via PATCH — do not send status_pembayaran in PATCH /rentals/{id}/status. Payment status values: 'Belum Dibayar' / 'DP / Sebagian' / 'Lunas' (StatusBadge still supports legacy 'DP'/'Belum bayar'). Invoice endpoint is public GET /api/invoices/{id} returning application/pdf (no auth). WA link testid pattern: rental-wa-{id} opens a shadcn DropdownMenu; wa-invoice-{id} anchor is only in the DOM while menu is open. To bypass CRA dev-mode ResizeObserver error overlay in Playwright, run: document.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(f=>f.remove()). Backend suite: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q  (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope). Test-data cleanup: python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_frontend_qa.py after UI runs.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects reproduced. Two pytest failures on first regression run were stale iteration_2 assertions against removed manual payment-status PATCH ('DP' vs new 'DP / Sebagian') — fixed test-side. One Playwright hang on wa-invoice-{id} was caused by the CRA dev-mode ResizeObserver error overlay blocking pointer events after the WA DropdownMenu opened; removing the CRA overlay iframe let the test read the link href correctly. Both were environmental, not product bugs.
